crossRefs.note: I will surely require accounting for your life’s blood. At the hand of every animal I will require it. At the hand of…
and also for the innocent blood that he shed; for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood, and Yahweh would not pardon.
For, behold, Yahweh comes out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The earth also…
that on you may come all the righteous blood shed on the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of…
that the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;
from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zachariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary.’ Yes, I tell you…
When he opened the fifth seal, I saw underneath the altar the souls of those who had been killed for the Word of God…
They cried with a loud voice, saying, “How long, Master, the holy and true, until you judge and avenge our blood on…
For they poured out the blood of saints and prophets, and you have given them blood to drink. They deserve this.”
But you do see trouble and grief. You consider it to take it into your hand. You help the victim and the fatherless.
Yahweh, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,
For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, Neither has he hidden his face from him; but when…
This poor man cried, and Yahweh heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.
Yahweh said, “I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their cry because of…
Now, behold, the cry of the children of Israel has come to me. Moreover I have seen the oppression with which the…
Won’t God avenge his chosen ones who are crying out to him day and night, and yet he exercises patience with them?
I tell you that he will avenge them quickly. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?”
They put away the foreign gods from among them and served Yahweh; and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.

translations.web: For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.
translations.bsb: For the Avenger of bloodshed remembers; He does not ignore the cry of the afflicted.
translations.kjv: When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.
translations.asv: For he that maketh inquisition for blood remembereth them; He forgetteth not the cry of the poor.
